execution: Executed on the provided NLST 512x512x150 NIfTI in the research container on 2026-11-23; these are observed measurements, not validation against independent ground truth.

mask.note: Midline isolation is an intentional conservative rule; it cannot establish correct medial lung anatomy.

A1_surface_observation.comment: Earlier right surface extended approximately 101.6 mm into the contralateral display hemisphere; this is a geometry red flag, not a measured Dice or accuracy error.

A2_surface.binary_artifact_distribution: Not uploaded to this GitHub commit; binary surfaces and masks are kept separate pending authorized, verified distribution and segmentation QA.

limitations: The right/left physical midline partition may cut true juxtamediastinal parenchyma.
The near-apical right candidate includes air up to source slice k=149 and requires expert review of whether connected central airway air was included.
HU-threshold airspace does not include consolidated/high-attenuation parenchyma or vascular tissue.
2 mm through-plane spacing limits precision of small airway/fissure geometry.
Watertightness and connectedness measure topology, not anatomical accuracy.
No reference segmentation exists here for Dice, Hausdorff, surface error or true sensitivity estimates.
